name: Potential Tampering With RDP Related Registry Keys Via Reg.EXE
description: Detects the execution of "reg.exe" for enabling/disabling the RDP service on the host by tampering with the 'CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' values
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:*\\reg.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:reg.exe) AND (process.command_line:*\ add\ * AND process.command_line:*\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Terminal\ Server* AND process.command_line:*REG_DWORD* AND process.command_line:*\ \/f*)) AND ((process.command_line:*Licensing\ Core* AND process.command_line:*EnableConcurrentSessions*) OR (process.command_line:(*WinStations\\RDP\-Tcp* OR *MaxInstanceCount* OR *fEnableWinStation* OR *TSUserEnabled* OR *TSEnabled* OR *TSAppCompat* OR *IdleWinStationPoolCount* OR *TSAdvertise* OR *AllowTSConnections* OR *fSingleSessionPerUser* OR *fDenyTSConnections*)))
